newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: South Seas owners okay 100 mln peso rights.
newsitem.headline: South Seas owners okay 100 mln peso rights.

text.p: Oil explorer South Seas Natural Resources Inc said on Wednesday its stockholders had approved a board resolution to sell up to 100 million pesos worth of shares through a rights offer.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange the shares would be sold at par and pro rata to all stockholders as of a certain date. The record date is yet to be determined.
The stockholders also approved the company's plan to increase its authorised capital stock to 400 million pesos from 200 million pesos.
